segments.text: Stickman aimed for productivity – Google had other ideas.
He sits, opens his laptop, and types 'how to be productive'.
The first link says 'How to procrastinate'.
He clicks and starts scrolling, his thought bubble pops up: 'Where did my to-do list go?' He forgets what he was supposed to do.
Now he’s scrolling instead of doing—Google’s original productivity hack.
Hit like if you've ever been stuck like Stickman.
